title: Add Customer Delivery Details Form Before Razorpay Payment

requirements.text: Update the Order and related backend data types to include customer delivery fields: fullName (Text), address (Text), and phoneNumber (Text). Ensure these fields are stored with every order record.

quotes: it should reflect in admin panel so that we can delivery to that address with proper name and phone number

acceptanceCriteria: Order type in backend/main.mo includes fullName, address, and phoneNumber fields
createOrder (or equivalent) backend function accepts and persists these three fields
Existing orders without these fields do not cause runtime errors (provide defaults if needed)

requirements.text: Insert a Customer Delivery Details form step between product/cart selection and the Razorpay payment initiation. The form must collect: Full Name, Delivery Address (multi-line), and Phone Number. Validate that all three fields are non-empty before allowing payment to proceed. This applies to both the 'Buy Now' flow on ProductDetail page and the checkout flow on the Cart page.

quotes: After the customer choose a product it directly goes to razor pay payment page. Customer should get a form to fill name, address phone number

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Buy Now' on the product detail page shows the delivery details form before opening Razorpay
Proceeding through the Cart/Checkout page shows the delivery details form before opening Razorpay
Form has labeled input fields for Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number
Submitting with any empty field shows a validation error and blocks payment
Razorpay checkout is only initiated after valid form submission
Collected name, address, and phone number are passed along with the order creation call

requirements.text: Display the customer delivery information (Full Name, Delivery Address, Phone Number) in the Admin Orders panel. Show these fields in the order list cards and in the OrderDetailModal so admins can fulfil deliveries.

quotes: it should reflect in admin panel so that we can delivery to that address with proper name and phone number
customer information is not visible no address no phone number where to deliver

acceptanceCriteria: AdminOrders page shows customer name and phone number on each order card
OrderDetailModal displays Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number in a clearly labeled section
Fields are visible for all new orders containing delivery details
If an older order has no delivery details, the fields display a fallback such as 'Not provided'

constraints: Do not replace or remove Razorpay integration — delivery details form must precede it, not replace it
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in the single actor file backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Changing the payment provider from Razorpay
Adding email or SMS notifications for orders
Implementing a full multi-step checkout wizard beyond the delivery details form
Modifying the existing admin authentication or admin login flow
